selection_protocol.method: rank UTC Mondays by SHA-256(seed:date), remove exact prior candidate weeks and candidates whose adjacent evaluation/context Mondays appear in the branch, then retain the first three unused non-overlapping weeks before any v33 performance run
selection_protocol.opening_rule: week 2 opens only after week 1 full_pass or promising_but_not_complete; week 3 opens only after week 2 also advances
selection_protocol.ablation_rule: if week 1 primary stops, run first-resolution-close-control on the identical week and identical union-plan official TradeTick stream; change only winning-resolution aggressive-flow agreement
selection_protocol.long_evaluation_rule: no long evaluation until all three frozen primary weeks advance without logic or parameter changes

frozen_market_logic.representation: daily causal cost-resolved equal-notional event bars calibrated only from the immediately preceding completed UTC day
frozen_market_logic.initiative: three-event coherent aggressive-flow shock, at least 40bp move, efficient path and close beyond completed 20-event external structure
frozen_market_logic.accepted_pullback: first later completed event with opposite aggressive flow and adverse close change while its close still preserves outside value
frozen_market_logic.branch_model: after the accepted pullback keep continuation and reversal branches simultaneously; neither direction is selected in advance
frozen_market_logic.continuation_resolution: later completed event closes beyond the frozen pullback extreme in the initiative direction
frozen_market_logic.reversal_resolution: later completed event closes through both the accepted boundary and the opposite frozen pullback extreme
frozen_market_logic.branch_invalidation: each branch is independently invalidated when price trades its opposite frozen pullback extreme plus one 7bp side-cost buffer; one branch may die while the other remains
frozen_market_logic.first_resolution_precedence: the first completed structural resolution ends the setup; trade only when that resolution belongs to a still-valid branch and did not hit its stop in the same completed event
frozen_market_logic.primary_confirmation: winning resolution event aggressive-flow sign agrees with the resolved direction
frozen_market_logic.single_ablation: close-control removes only winning-event aggressive-flow agreement; branch states, resolution order, entry, stop, target, risk, cost and hold remain unchanged
frozen_market_logic.entry: NautilusTrader market bracket on the first official venue TradeTick strictly after the completed winning resolution
frozen_market_logic.invalidation_after_entry: opposite frozen pullback extreme plus one 7bp side-cost buffer for the resolved direction
frozen_market_logic.target: nearest active unconsumed completed UTC-day or completed Monday-Sunday week high/low strictly beyond the pre-initiative 20-event structure edge in the resolved direction
frozen_market_logic.calendar_causality: day/week levels activate only after their source period completes and are removed on the first later completed equal-notional event whose range trades them
frozen_market_logic.ambiguous_same_event_rule: if a completed resolution event also trades the resolved branch stop, reject the scenario rather than infer intrabar ordering
frozen_market_logic.execution_data: official Binance Vision USD-M BTCUSDT aggregate trades converted one-for-one to NautilusTrader TradeTick

structural_rationale.v30: forcing continuation after accepted pullback lost on both first- and second-expansion targets
structural_rationale.v31: forcing reversal with a one-tick boundary trigger produced five stops, while immediate reversal was weakly positive but regime asymmetric
structural_rationale.v32: completed reversal MSS with calendar targets still lost and flow agreement did not discriminate because every structural MSS was flow aligned
structural_rationale.v33_hypothesis: the accepted pullback is an unresolved two-sided auction; independent branch invalidation and first completed resolution should avoid choosing continuation or reversal before the market resolves it
